purpose: Exploratory method-blind rerating of the frozen September 23 v4 PF paper-setting benchmark, whose four generation conditions all received the five Table 1 anchors.

generation_anchor_parity.direct_prompt: The frozen v4 copy of src/generation/prompts/pf_paper_benchmark.yaml includes all fifteen published anchors.
generation_anchor_parity.pipeline_prompt: The frozen v4 copy of src/generation/prompts/situation_skeletons.yaml includes all fifteen published anchors in proposal and writer guidance.
generation_anchor_parity.interpretation: This is a closer prompt-exposure comparison than the original v1 generation set; it remains a post-hoc method-package comparison, not an isolated prompt-component test.

input_policy.target_source: The fixed target_concept from the frozen v4 benchmark configuration.
input_policy.prior_knowledge_source: The fixed learner_context from the frozen v4 benchmark configuration.
input_policy.rationale: The common target and learner context support target-relative task-level ratings and are identical across conditions; only student-facing task text varies.

calibration.selection: Uniform seeded sample without replacement from ready tasks within each condition; calls interleaved one per condition per round.
calibration.gate: Check API completion and strict response-schema validity only. Do not tune the prompt or interpret score differences. Stop the full run if any calibration case has an API, runner, or schema failure.

failure_policy.non_ready: Record blocked, invalid, failed, and other non-ready generation attempts as not eligible; do not call the judge or assign scores.
failure_policy.judge_failure: Retain explicit API, runner, invalid-response, interrupted, or insufficient-evidence status; missing scores are not zero.
failure_policy.resume: Reuse completed per-task ratings, never overwrite them, and do not automatically repeat an interrupted or failed call.
failure_policy.denominators: Report all 30 scheduled attempts, ready tasks, non-ready statuses, attempted ratings, and valid scores by condition.

interpretation.claim: Exploratory automated rerating under an anchor-preserving v2 operational interpretation.
not_claimed: Exact reproduction of the paper's rating guidance or human-rating procedure.
Human agreement, task validity, actual student approach diversity, productive failure, or learning.
A confirmatory comparison or evidence that one generation method is generally superior.
